items.text: Céline Dion's "My Heart Will Go On" was one of the 16 singles that reached number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1998.
items.question: Where were you living when Céline Dion's "My Heart Will Go On" was number one, and who in your house sang along?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart that ranks the best-performing singles of the United States. Published by Billboard magazine, the data are compiled by Nielsen SoundScan based collectively on each single's weekly physical sales and airplay. In 1998, there were 16 singles that topped the chart, in 52 issue dates.
825 February 28 "My Heart Will Go On" Céline Dion

items.text: On September 8, 1998, Mark McGwire of the St. Louis Cardinals broke baseball's single-season home run record, held since 1961 by Roger Maris.
items.question: Where were you when Mark McGwire hit his 62nd home run, and who were you watching or listening with?
items.source_quote: September 8 – St. Louis Cardinals first baseman Mark McGwire breaks baseball's single-season home run record, formerly held since 1961 by Roger Maris. McGwire hits #62 at Busch Stadium

items.text: Google, Inc. was founded in Menlo Park, California, on September 4, 1998, by Larry Page and Sergey Brin.
items.question: Do you remember the first time you searched for something on Google, and who showed you how?
items.source_quote: September 4 – Google, Inc. is founded in Menlo Park, California, by Stanford University Ph.D. candidates Larry Page and Sergey Brin.
